```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0,
                 fill = "firebrick", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "How critics score films on Rotten Tomatoes",
    subtitle = paste(format(nrow(movies), big.mark = ","), "films"),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count",
    caption = "Source: Rotten Tomatoes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
